title: Japanese-Style Chicken Skewers with Charred Glaze
description: A sweet and savory recipe featuring charred tsukune glaze on skewered chicken, inspired by Japanese flavors.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and vegetable oil. Add the chicken pieces and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
5. While the chicken is cooking, prepare the charred tsukune glaze by whisking together the charred tsukune sauce, grated ginger, and a pinch of salt.
6. Once the chicken is cooked, brush the charred tsukune glaze onto the skewers during the last minute of grilling.
7. Serve the skewers hot, garnished with green onions and additional charred tsukune glaze if desired.
